acceptanceCriteria: A worktree whose only dirty paths are Tasks-store projection files reports source freshness clean plus a separate task-state member, in impact, context and hook packets, with tests.
The owning freshness specs record the rule.
body: PR #1314 (AFP-V0-088) projects .taskman/ files as nonSource task state in affected plans, but AC2 was NOT_PRODUCED: gokernel repositoryFromObservation (`mixed`) and internal/worktreeimpact (`mixed-worktree`) still treat projection-only dirt as source dirt, so every context and hook packet degrades in Tasks repositories (core-history, oscillux, Corvint).
title: Impact/context freshness reports Tasks-store (.taskman/) dirt separately instead of degrading to mixed-worktree (V1-2049 AC2 residual)
